spec.title: Two-compartment spare-parts kit
spec.instruction: Assemble the two-compartment box, check the two types of spare parts separately and place them in their respective inserts. Prepare the inventory list and load both inserts into the outer box using both units. Insert the list, seal and weigh the package, and apply a label.
